reviews.author: Xavier

reviews.title: Great value SFX PSU
reviews.comment: Needed a SFX PSU for a SFF build and this checked all the boxes. For a 850w Platinum, you are getting a lot of value for the money. Cables are easy to work with and just long enough. The on/off switch extensions is very convenient since some Sff cases have the PSU sitting inside plugged into an extender leading to the back without a switch. Noise is mainly audible on start up but after boot most of the noise is canceled out by other components. It’s quiet overall and temps are good; just warm to the touch. I am happy with my purchase.
reviews.author: justin
